description: Directs Governed SDD agents to discover the ADR that governs a question with `meridian adr list`, and archives queue sections from task state.
delta: The context policy's minimal-read-only-status block and the implementation, remediation, and review procedures' bounded-context-readers blocks each add one sentence naming `meridian adr list`, which prints one line per ADR with its ID, title, and status. No gate, role, or review rule changes; `meridian adr show` and `meridian context authority` remain the readers of an ADR's body. The worktree-lifecycle block replaces the conservative queue-section archival text with the state-based rule: a section that lists task rows closes when every row's state file is terminal (DONE in Lean Delivery; ACCEPTED, ANSWERED, or INCONCLUSIVE in Governed SDD), at any heading level and whatever the table shape; a row without a state file keeps the `###` table rule and a mixed section needs both rules to agree. The adoption text names `meridian task state import --include-terminal` and that integrate stage reports every archived and retained section. No gate is relaxed and INCONCLUSIVE still does not satisfy a dependency.
upgradeNotes: Run upgrade --apply to install the ADR discovery sentence (Governed SDD) and the state-based queue archival rule in docs/WORKTREE_LIFECYCLE.md (both modes); adapted archival text may conflict. Then run `meridian task state import --include-terminal` to preview state for terminal legacy tasks and repeat with --apply so their sections archive by state. No protocolVersion change.
verification: a clean Governed SDD upgrade installs minimal-read-only-status v3 in the context policy and bounded-context-readers v2 in the implementation, remediation, and review procedures while preserving consumer-owned text
meridian adr list prints one line per ADR and agrees with meridian adr show on which entries exist
a section whose task rows all have terminal state files archives at any heading level, an INCONCLUSIVE spike closes its section, and a project without state files archives exactly as before
integrate stage reports every archived and retained section with its reason
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 scripts/run_tests.py --parallel pass
